description: This file defines the StandingInstructionsHelper class which provides helper methods to create, retrieve, and manage standing instructions within the Finereact integration tests suite. It includes methods to build JSON payloads for standing instructions, create instructions on the server, and retrieve instructions or their histories.

classes.name: StandingInstructionsHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing standing instructions in Finereact integration tests. Provides methods to build instruction JSON payloads, create instructions, and retrieve instructions and histories.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs JSON payload string for creating a standing instruction with specified parameters.

methods.name: createStandingInstruction
methods.description: Creates a new standing instruction on the server using the specified parameters.

methods.name: getStandingInstructionById
methods.description: Retrieves a standing instruction by its ID from the server.

methods.name: getStandingInstructionHistory
methods.description: Fetches the history of standing instructions based on provided filters.
